evidence.detail: Exact-v308 reverse references outside the class itself point only to R361 SpriteStyleTransformer (rs/l/n).
The utility clamps/normalizes style parameters, adjusts packed color hue bits, and performs RGB hue/strength/percentage transformations without owning unrelated state.
SpriteStyleTransformer invokes this utility while rewriting Sprite pixel colors and preserves the source alpha channel around the transformed RGB value.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 utility name scoped to its only live consumer. It does not claim an original stripped source identifier.

evidence.detail: Exact-v308 reverse references outside the class itself point only to R362 TextParticleMarkup (rs/l/t).
The class is an access-order LinkedHashMap<Long,Long> and removes the eldest entry when size exceeds exactly 512.
TextParticleMarkup stores a hash-derived long key to current millisecond timestamp in this map and checks elapsed time against 50 ms before regenerating particle-related values.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the bounded key-to-timestamp cache owned exclusively by TextParticleMarkup.
